backup.production_rule: Function replacement only: get_admin_overview_v1(uuid), patched from its LIVE body (md5(prosrc) 1604680f29ac95624c67d830d887627f, read 2026-10-07, equal to 20260916150000_admin_overview_handoffs_open.sql). One line changes: finance.unpaidCleanerFees counts cleaning_sessions with fee_paid_at null and (fee_amount null or > 0) instead of fee_amount > 0 and fee_paid_at null. Grants re-asserted as read live (authenticated EXECUTE only; anon, service_role, PUBLIC none). No table, column, row or other function touched. restore_point and verified_at are placeholders: take a fresh backup as the LAST act before the apply and fill both (fill-restore-point.mjs).

forward_verification.name: unpaid_fees_counts_unpriced_cleans
forward_verification.query: select prosrc like '%c.fee_paid_at is null and (c.fee_amount is null or c.fee_amount > 0)%' and prosrc not like '%c.fee_amount > 0 and c.fee_paid_at is null%' from pg_proc where oid = 'public.get_admin_overview_v1(uuid)'::regprocedure

forward_verification.name: only_the_fee_rule_changed
forward_verification.query: select md5(replace(regexp_replace(prosrc, ' +-- SPEC-37: [^' || chr(10) || ']*' || chr(10), ''), 'c.fee_paid_at is null and (c.fee_amount is null or c.fee_amount > 0)', 'c.fee_amount > 0 and c.fee_paid_at is null')) = '1604680f29ac95624c67d830d887627f' from pg_proc where oid = 'public.get_admin_overview_v1(uuid)'::regprocedure

forward_verification.name: overview_keeps_definer_search_path_and_grants
forward_verification.query: select p.prosecdef and p.proconfig = array['search_path=""'] and p.provolatile = 's' and has_function_privilege('authenticated', 'public.get_admin_overview_v1(uuid)', 'execute') and not has_function_privilege('anon', 'public.get_admin_overview_v1(uuid)', 'execute') and not has_function_privilege('service_role', 'public.get_admin_overview_v1(uuid)', 'execute') from pg_proc p where p.oid = 'public.get_admin_overview_v1(uuid)'::regprocedure

steps.name: run_compensating_script
steps.action: apply supabase/rollbacks/20261007_admin_overview_unpaid_fees_unpriced.sql with run-sql-on-host.sh: restores the 20260916150000 body (md5(prosrc) 1604680f29ac95624c67d830d887627f). Grants are untouched by create or replace.

feature_flags.name: dashboard_unpaid_filter_same_rule
feature_flags.required_state: admin-dashboard: /operations?fees=unpaid now filters fee_paid_at null and (fee_amount null or > 0), the Paid column and the cleaning detail say Unpaid (not "no fee") for an unpriced clean; publish that build after this release. Old dashboard + new function is harmless: the Today count is right, the linked list shows only priced rows until the build is published. No Edge Function, staff app or Apps Script reads unpaidCleanerFees.

compatibility.evidence: Same JSON shape; the number grows by the unpriced unpaid cleans. Production read-only 2026-10-07: cleaning_types turnover / mid_stay / deep_clean, all paid (staff_pay_candidates_v1 offers every fee_paid_at-null session, deep_clean at the general rate); 5 historic turnovers carry fee 0 and are settled; the new rule returns 2 (48e269c6 Oct 4-5, 3216c2bd Oct 7, Honey, fee NULL, no pay request), the old rule 0. Readers of unpaidCleanerFees: admin-dashboard today-page.tsx and today/api.ts only.
